patch.value: pm validate reports stored identities that carry URL userinfo, with a rewrite remediation

Follow-up to pm-gh1707. New writes strip URL userinfo from author, assignee and claim principal, and refusals and claim envelopes redact a stored one, but a holder written by an older version stays in the item file and in full item reads (pm get, list, claim with full changed fields) as stored. Nothing tells a maintainer that such a record exists. pm validate (and pm health) should report each item whose author, assignee or claim_principal carries URL userinfo, by item id and field only, never the value, with the remediation pm update <id> --assignee <name> or a fresh claim, so a tracker can be cleaned deliberately instead of by accident.

pm validate and pm health report items whose author, assignee or claim_principal carries URL userinfo, naming the item id and field but never the value; Each finding carries the rewrite remediation; A tracker without such records reports nothing
A maintainer learns about legacy credential-bearing identities and can rewrite them
Legacy identities with URL userinfo are invisible until echoed in full item reads
